lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A linear horizontal sequence of high-luminance, roughly circular white spots located along the lower mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent dark horizontal band running through the mid-lateral surface, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher intensity above and a dark shadow line below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular dark area of physical trauma or scarring on the mid-flank, disrupting the natural spot and ridge pattern, located anterior to the caudal region.
